text.p: Peter Graf arrived at a German prison hospital on Monday to begin a sentence for evading millions of dollars in tax on his daughter Steffi Graf's income, state justice officials said.
Justice officials did not say why Graf had begun his jail term in the prison hospital.

Graf was sentenced in January to three years and nine months in jail but it is likely he will serve a much shorter term as he had already spent considerable time in investigative custody during the probe into the family tax affairs.
Prosecutors dropped investigations against Steffi Graf herself in March after she agreed to make a donation to charity. Media reports put the sum at 1.3 million marks ($700,000).
